description: Brazilian FIPE reference price for one car: brand, model, model year, fuel, FIPE code and reference month, from the public FIPE API. Needs the FIPE brand, model and year codes (numbers and a 'year-fuel' code); lookup lists are at /cars/brands. Reference prices are not a sale offer. Choose this tool for: Brazilian FIPE reference price for one car: brand, model. Close alternatives on this server: travel_carfax (CARFAX used-car listings by body style or price ceiling); travel_carsdirect_vehicle (CarsDirect used-car listings near a US ZIP code: vehicle). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

brand.description: FIPE brand code, digits only (e.g. 21 = Fiat)

year.description: FIPE year code like 1985-1 (year and fuel code)
